title: Store floor & devices
description: One store's in-store pieces together: the store hub (callout box), the Pi, the tablets and floor, and printing.

list.name: store
list.label: Store
list.description: Store slug (tenant) from the Pis' and hubs' resource labels.

panels.title: Hub → Pi
panels.description: Whether the hub can reach the Pi's integration API. DOWN: order callouts stop.

panels.title: Pi sees hub
panels.description: Whether the Pi has heard from the hub recently (the Pi's side of the link).

panels.title: Hub version
panels.description: The hub build running now.

panels.title: Feed lag
panels.description: How far behind the hub is on the Pi's change feed. Red over 60 s: order callouts are late.

panels.title: Pi version
panels.description: The agent build running on the Pi now.

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: Time since the agent last started. A reset you didn't expect means a crash or power cut.

panels.title: Temperature
panels.description: CPU temperature. Red over 80 °C: the Pi throttles; check its airflow.

panels.title: Disk free
panels.description: Free space on the SD card. Red under 1 GB.

panels.title: SD card errors
panels.description: SD card I/O errors in the selected range. Any: replace the card soon (deploy/pi/RECOVERY.md).

panels.title: Last update
panels.description: When the Pi last updated itself successfully.

panels.title: Temperature
panels.description: CPU temperature over time.

panels.title: Disk free
panels.description: SD card free space over time.

panels.title: Update runs
panels.description: Self-update attempts by result (up_to_date, ok, failed, rolled_back).

panels.title: Tablets
panels.description: Quibase tablets connected to the Pi now. 0: nobody hears new orders ring.

panels.title: Open orders
panels.description: Orders on the floor right now, by state.

panels.title: Accept p95
panels.description: Ring to accept (p95, selected range). Red over 2 min: orders sit unaccepted.

panels.title: Sync backlog
panels.description: Floor changes waiting to reach main. Growing: the Pi lost main.

panels.title: Driver routes
panels.description: Route messages sent to drivers' phones at SEND OUT (selected range). rejected: Pushover refused it (bad device key).

panels.title: Open orders by state
panels.description: new = ringing, cooking, ready, out with a driver, scheduled = future orders.

panels.title: Accept time p95
panels.description: Ring to accept, online vs POS.

panels.title: Floor sync p95 by type
panels.description: Pi floor change to main, by event type.

panels.title: Printers
panels.description: Each printer as last probed by the Pi. DOWN: tickets reroute (REROUTED banner).

panels.title: Print failures
panels.description: Orders that failed to print anywhere (selected range).

panels.title: Print p95
panels.description: Accept to tickets printed (p95, selected range).

panels.title: Reprints
panels.description: Receipt reprints and kitchen resends from the tablet (selected range).

panels.title: Tickets per printer
panels.description: Jobs each printer took in the selected range.

panels.title: Items routed
panels.description: Order items main matched to a station printer vs. unmatched (unmatched items print on every ticket in full). A rising unmatched count means the menu's printer assignments need a look.

panels.title: Tickets per printer
panels.description: Print jobs per printer over time.

panels.title: Printer write p95
panels.description: Time to send a job to each printer.

panels.title: Printer probe p95
panels.description: Time each printer takes to answer the Pi's status probe. A slow or climbing line is a printer about to drop off.
